metadata.title: Connect Devices
metadata.description: Share your fitness tracker or smartphone app with us.

options.title: TASK: Connect my device(s)
options.description:
Click on the connect button for your device.

The study team will collect past physical activity data, if available, from 1st July 2016 until 31st December 2024. This will be a one-off transfer of data. We will not collect any activity data beyond the 31st December 2024.

devices.title: Fitbit Tab
devices.description: Before clicking Connect, you can read [step-by-step instructions](/study/paprka/resources/guides/PAPrKA_Study_Guide_Fitbit.docx) or watch a video [link TBC] to see how to share your Fitbit physical activity data.

account.title: Register Account
account.description:
You need an account to give us your information and connect your fitness tracker or smartphone app.
You can find out more information about the way we use personal information, and the rights individuals have to control and manage their data in our [privacy policy](https://documents.manchester.ac.uk/display.aspx?DocID=37095)
